items.body: Living space below grade takes the first hit.
We figure out which one you have.

bodies: Some basement water is a plumbing problem and some is a foundation problem. We handle the plumbing side: backflow valves, standpipes, [overhead sewer systems](/chicago-lincoln-park/overhead-sewer-systems), [sump pumps](/chicago-lincoln-park/sump-pumps) and battery backups.
If water is coming through cracks in old foundation walls, a waterproofing contractor is the right call, and we'll tell you so. In Chicago, the sewer side is often the bigger problem.

blocks.h2: Protecting a Lincoln Park Garden Unit
blocks.body: For a below-grade apartment, protection works in layers. Keep the patio, stairwell and gangway drains clear. Make sure the sump pump has a battery backup. If sewer water has ever come up the floor drain, consider an overhead sewer, which keeps the unit separate from the city sewer during storms. In a condo building, these are usually association decisions, so we provide footage and a written plan.

blocks.h2: Basement Flooding Questions From Lincoln Park Homeowners

items.q: Is it sewer water or groundwater?
items.answer: Water rising through the floor drain is usually sewer water. Water at the walls is groundwater.

items.q: Do you remove water from flooded basements?
items.preview: We fix the cause. Restoration companies dry and clean.
items.answer: We fix the plumbing cause. For water removal and drying, a restoration company is the right call.

items.q: What protects a garden unit best?
items.preview: An overhead sewer for repeat backups.
items.answer: For repeat sewer backups, an overhead sewer system. For lighter risk, a backflow valve or standpipe.

items.preview: Possibly, until the basement is protected.
items.answer: If the city sewer filled up, it can happen in the next big storm. Protection stops it.

items.q: Can a backflow valve be installed in a condo building?
items.answer: Yes, usually with association approval, since it affects shared plumbing.

items.q: How much does basement flooding repair cost in Lincoln Park?
items.preview: It depends on the cause. You'll approve a flat price first.
items.answer: It depends on the cause and what needs to be fixed or added. You'll approve a flat-rate price before we start.
